answer_text: Mr. Johnson chose the surname "Douglass," suggested by the "Lady of the Lake," which he had just been reading.

Order, number 3 in his list, with the precept "Let all your things have their places; let each part of your business have its time." Franklin says this scheme gave him the most trouble. He found it practicable only for someone like a journeyman printer who controlled his own time, but not for a master who must mix with the world and receive people of business at their own hours. He also found Order with regard to places for things, papers, etc., extremely difficult to acquire.
